operations.name: create
operations.handle_obligation: The caller owns the move-only TaskHandle until it is awaited, detached, or dropped.
operations.result_obligation: The promise result is pending and has no readable payload.
guarantees: Async function creation does not execute its body.

operations.name: activate
operations.handle_obligation: start, await, and wait may activate a created handle; repeated start does not create a second execution.
operations.result_obligation: The result remains pending until terminal completion.
guarantees: start queues work and never inlines the task body on the caller stack.

operations.name: await
operations.handle_obligation: The awaiter is resumed exactly once after the child becomes terminal.
operations.result_obligation: A normal ready-live result is consumed once; a canceled result propagates cancellation and does not fabricate a payload.
guarantees: Completion before continuation registration remains linearized.

operations.name: await-outcome
operations.handle_obligation: The awaiter is resumed exactly once after the child becomes terminal.
operations.result_obligation: A normal ready-live result is consumed once as Some(T); a canceled result is represented as None without fabricating T.
guarantees: Cancellation capture is explicit at the .await? boundary.

operations.name: cancel
operations.handle_obligation: Cancellation marks the task and wakes or queues a suspended task so that cleanup can run.
operations.result_obligation: A canceled completion publishes canceled, never a readable result payload.
guarantees: Cancellation is inherited by an awaited child and cancels active wait registrations.

operations.name: drop
operations.handle_obligation: Dropping a created handle reclaims its frame; dropping an activated handle transfers runtime ownership through detach.
operations.result_obligation: An unstarted frame drops frame-owned cede parameters without running the body.
guarantees: Owner release is linearized exactly once.

operations.name: detach
operations.handle_obligation: The runtime owns an activated detached task until it reaches a terminal state.
operations.result_obligation: A detached task result is not exposed to the caller; an untaken live result is reclaimed with its frame.
guarantees: block_on drains runtime-owned detached work before executor shutdown.

result_states.name: ready-live
result_states.meaning: A normal result payload is available for exactly one take.

result_states.name: taken
result_states.meaning: The normal payload was consumed and cannot be taken again.

result_states.name: canceled
result_states.meaning: Cancellation completed without publishing a result payload.

proves: created drop does not execute the body
frame-owned cede parameter is reclaimed exactly once
runtime-owned detached work drains before block_on returns
detached frame local is dropped exactly once
canceled await has no fabricated payload
current task cancellation can return a domain outcome
